data.display_address: Grand Bleu Tower 1, Emaar Beachfront, Dubai Harbour, Dubai
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate proudly presents this exceptional 2-bedroom apartment in Grand Bleu Tower 1 at EMAAR Beachfront, an exclusive waterfront address designed in collaboration with the internationally acclaimed fashion house Elie Saab. Offered for AED 300,000 per annum, this fully furnished residence delivers an unparalleled beachfront lifestyle with breathtaking panoramic sea views and direct private beach access.

Thoughtfully designed with sophisticated interiors and premium finishes, the apartment features a spacious open-plan living and dining area, floor-to-ceiling windows that maximize natural light, and a fully fitted and equipped contemporary kitchen. Every detail has been carefully curated to provide elegance, comfort, and functionality, making it an ideal home for those seeking luxury coastal living in one of Dubai's most prestigious waterfront communities.

Property Features:
2 Spacious Bedrooms
2 Modern Bathrooms
Fully Furnished
Fully Fitted & Equipped Kitchen
Built-up Area: 1,576 sq.ft.
Full Sea Views
Vacant & Ready to Move In
Spacious Balcony
Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
Premium Finishes Throughout
Covered Parking
Direct Private Beach Access
Building Amenities:
Private Beach Access
Infinity Swimming Pool
Fully Equipped Fitness Centre
Landscaped Leisure & Relaxation Areas
Children's Play Area
Concierge Services
24/7 Security
Residents' Lounge
Retail & Dining Outlets
Prime Location:
Ideally positioned within Dubai Harbour, EMAAR Beachfront offers residents seamless connectivity to Dubai's most prominent destinations.

Dubai Marina – 5 Minutes
Palm Jumeirah – 10 Minutes
Downtown Dubai – 20 Minutes
Dubai International Airport – 25 Minutes
Grand Bleu Tower by Elie Saab is one of EMAAR Beachfront's most iconic developments, offering a rare combination of designer living, world-class amenities, and an exclusive beachfront setting. Whether enjoying uninterrupted sea views from your home or relaxing on the private beach, this residence presents an exceptional lifestyle defined by luxury, privacy, and convenience.
